pages.text: $(thing)Struggle$() is a friendly player-versus-player match fought with toy bats. Place a $(item)Struggle Board$() and right-click it to create a match: you become the owner and get to set the arena corners and the game mode.$(p)There are three modes: $(thing)Duel$() (1v1), $(thing)Tournament$() (round-based bracket) and $(thing)Free For All$().

To take part you need one of the three weapons in your hotbar: $(item)Struggle Sword$(), $(item)Struggle Hammer$() or $(item)Struggle Wand$(). During a match you're locked to that weapon and can't switch items.$(p)Hitting an opponent knocks orbs off them; whoever holds the most when time runs out wins. The winner is announced in chat.
Save a board's location with $(thing)sneak + right-click$(), place it on a wall, then tune a $(item)compass$() to it to find the arena again.
Full rules, scoring and settings are on the external wiki.
